CustomField.description: Optional SOQL WHERE clause, without the word WHERE. :recordId is the record the component is placed on and :userId is the running user, e.g. "AccountId = :recordId AND IsClosed = false". Leave blank to list every record the user can see, up to the Row Limit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: SOQL conditions without WHERE. Use :recordId for the current record and :userId for the running user.
CustomField.label: Filter
